statement: For every r>=1 and r+2<=N<=2r+1, a specified regular ambient strict local source has zero CH^r while its regular principal puncture has a non-torsion ordinary algebraically trivial class
depends_on: C.3e strict-local cone injection; C.3s finite-data descent; C.3r transverse join construction; C.2b affine vanishing and Poincare duality; Skalit2017 Corollary6.4(i)
notes: Fermat degree d+2 with d=2r-N+2 and k=N-r-2 paired suspensions. Integral transverse correspondence identity gives a cohomological left inverse. The specified generic-point class cannot lie in H CH^(r-1), by its exact Hodge shift below the middle. Actual fixed-product curve families are retained.
